bullets.text: Ofcom's 6 GHz Spectrum Strategy - Ofcom proposes a split-priority approach for mobile and Wi-Fi services in the 6 GHz band.
Vodafone's Ad Campaign Banned - ASA bans Vodafone's 'Nation's Network' ads for misleading claims about network superiority.
BT Sells US Federal Unit - BT divests its US government contracting operation to focus on multi-cloud services.
Cyberattack Costs Surge - Average recovery costs from cyberattacks reach $2.5 million, highlighting resilience challenges.
AI's Role in Telecom Networks - AI and ML are increasingly integrated into service provider networks to enhance performance.
6G Networks to Automate Workflows - Future 6G networks will host AI agents to automate complex enterprise workflows.
UK Government Cybersecurity Investment - The UK government allocates £210 million to enhance public sector cyber defences.
SoftBank's DigitalBridge Acquisition - SoftBank's acquisition of DigitalBridge reflects AI's impact on telecom infrastructure strategy.
FCC Votes on 6 GHz Devices - FCC proposes new 'geofenced variable power' devices for enhanced outdoor Wi-Fi capabilities.
